To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality of the measurements is better for the configuration of two IMUs mounted on the front and rear axles of the mobile robot, than for the configuration of one IMU on the rear axle.

1) the quality of data obtained using the configuration with two IMUs mounted on a single platform is better than in the configuration with two independent IMUs, and 2) the quality of motion parameters estimation using the configuration with one IMU is the worst of the three configurations considered.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method of improving quality of data obtained by a scanning head of a mobile robot by using information about the robot motion parameters.
development of a cost effective method of improvement of quality and accuracy of 3D data obtained from a mobile robot equipped with a 3D laser scanner.
the development of a cost-effective solution to the problem of determination motion parameters of mobile robots using IMUs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best results were obtained for configuration with two IMUs mounted at the front of the robot, which is the most cost effective solution.
the most precise configuration of IMUs is the one where IMU is mounted on the mobile robot in such a way that the axes of IMU coincide with the axes of the robot.
the best quality is provided by the configuration in which the IMU is mounted on the robot base.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
all three configurations of IMU can be used to determine motion parameters of a robot, however, for the configuration with two IMUs the quality of the results is significantly better.
the most promising configuration is the one in which two IMUs are placed on the front and the rear of the robot and one IMU is placed on the robot's body.
it is possible to improve the quality of data obtained by a 3D scanner by using the information about the robot motion parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the configuration of IMUs with three accelerometers and one gyroscope is the best one for the considered problem.
the use of the IMUs in a specific configuration can improve the quality of data obtained with a 3D scanner mounted on the robot.
it is possible to improve precision of measurements of motion parameters using IMUs by applying them in appropriate configurations.
